visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) [People]: An animated man with short black hair wearing a black tank top stands in a frozen, panicked pose with his mouth wide open. [Objects]: Large, stylized orange and yellow flames flicker in the bottom foreground. [Setting]: Behind the man is a gray industrial landscape with a factory, smoking chimneys, and power line towers under an overcast gray sky. [Text]: Yellow Chinese text is positioned at the top. (2) [People]: The same man is seen from the torso up, his expression terrified and sweat beads visible on his face. [Objects]: A massive, curling teal wave with white foam rises from the left and completely washes over him. [Setting]: The industrial background is now obscured by the sheer volume of water. [Text]: Black-outlined yellow text appears at the top. (3) [People]: The man's head is shown bobbing above dark blue water, his eyes wide and mouth gasping as if drowning. [Objects]: Small white splashes surround his head. [Setting]: In the distance, a dark city skyline with tall buildings is visible under a dim, cloudy sky. [Text]: Yellow subtitles are centered at the top. (4) [People]: The man lies flat on his back in a bed, looking upward with a dazed expression; he then sits up abruptly, eyes bulging and mouth agape. [Objects]: He is on a bed with a white pillow and green patterned sheets. [Setting]: A simple bedroom with a window showing a bright day and a framed picture on the wall. [Text]: Yellow subtitles appear above him. (5) [People]: The man stands in a living room, holding one hand out with an expression of shock and awe. [Objects]: A swirling blue and purple energy portal opens in front of him, glowing with a bright white center star. [Setting]: A cozy living room with a green sofa, a potted plant, and a painting on the wall. [Text]: Yellow subtitles are at the top. (6) [People]: The man stands outside, holding a giant paper check with both hands, wearing a triumphant and greedy grin. [Objects]: The check is white with 'PAY TO THE ORDER OF 800,000,000元' printed on it in bold black letters. [Setting]: In front of a yellow 'Lottery Shop' building with a red awning and a dollar sign logo. [Text]: Subtitles are at the top. (7) [People]: The man stands next to a truck, holding a smartphone to his ear, winking and looking extremely pleased with himself. [Objects]: A white cargo truck is parked behind him, its flatbed stacked high with red boxes of instant noodles. [Setting]: A bright urban street with a fountain and green bushes in the background. [Text]: Subtitles at the top. (8) [People]: The man sits on the edge of his bed, holding a black smartphone and looking at it with a sweating, anxious expression. [Objects]: The smartphone is held in his right hand. [Setting]: The bedroom from earlier, with the window and curtains visible. [Text]: Yellow subtitles appear at the top center. (9) [People]: Not visible. [Objects]: A close-up of a smartphone screen showing a white interface with black text reading '2025年6月5日' and various notification icons. [Setting]: The background is the blurred bedroom wall. [Text]: Large yellow subtitles are overlaid on the screen content. (10) [People]: The man is sitting in bed wearing dark sunglasses, looking at his phone with a cool, confident expression. [Objects]: He holds the phone in one hand. [Setting]: Dimmer lighting in the bedroom suggesting night or evening. [Text]: Yellow subtitles at the top. (11) [People]: A man and a woman are lying in bed next to each other, both staring at their respective smartphones without interacting. [Objects]: They are covered by a thick gray duvet; both hold black smartphones. [Setting]: A bedroom with a plain white wall and a lamp. [Text]: Subtitles at the top. (12) [People]: The woman turns her head to look at the man with a judgmental, deadpan expression, while the man keeps staring at his phone. [Objects]: Both hold black smartphones. [Setting]: Same bedroom as the previous phase. [Text]: Large yellow subtitles appear, quoting the woman's dialogue.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 7月5號末日降臨. [Logo]: 霸軒BAXUAN. (2) [Subtitle]: 地震海嘯席捲而來. (3) [Subtitle]: 上一世我被海嘯活活淹死. (4) [Subtitle]: 這一世我重生了. (5) [Subtitle]: 還意外得到了打開異空間的能力. (6) [Subtitle]: 我利用上一世的記憶. [Slogan]: 彩券行. [Logo]: $. [Slogan]: PAY TO THE ORDER OF 800,000,000元. (7) [Subtitle]: 買了威力彩中了頭獎八億. (8) [Subtitle]: 開啟了我的瘋狂囤物資計劃. (9) [Subtitle]: 我張開眼睛. (10) [Subtitle]: 不可置信的看著眼前熟悉的場景. (11) [Subtitle]: 拿起手機一看. (12) [Subtitle]: 現在是2025年6月5日. (13) [Subtitle]: 離末日還有整整30天. (14) [Subtitle]: 這一世我必定會做好準備. (15) [Subtitle]: 看著我在原地發呆. (16) [Subtitle]: 小美緊張的問我. (17) [Subtitle]: 那種笨笨的影片少看一點. [Logo]: 霸軒BAXUAN.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) [Vocals]: A high-pitched, excited male voice narrates with fast speed and dramatic intensity about the apocalypse. [Music]: Fast-paced cinematic music with heavy orchestral percussion and a sense of urgency. [SFX]: Sounds of crackling fire and low rumbling atmosphere. (2) [Vocals]: Narrator continues his intense delivery as the wave hits. [Music]: The music reaches a crescendo with a sharp brass hit. [SFX]: A loud, drowning water splash and rushing liquid sound. (3) [Vocals]: Narrator speaks with a slightly muffled quality. [Music]: Music drops in volume, replaced by low-frequency drones. [SFX]: Bubbling and underwater gurgling sounds. (4) [Vocals]: A sudden gasp followed by a more conversational male voice. [Music]: A whimsical, light-hearted synth melody begins, mid-tempo. [SFX]: A 'pop' sound effect signaling rebirth. (5) [Vocals]: Narrator continues with a tone of wonder. [Music]: BGM continues with a bouncy, electronic pop feel. [SFX]: A magical 'whoosh' and a low electric humming sound from the portal. (6) [Vocals]: Narrator's tone becomes boastful. [Music]: Music rhythm becomes more prominent with a steady beat. [SFX]: A classic cash register 'cha-ching' sound. (7) [Vocals]: Narrator is heard through a simulated phone filter, sounding distant and tinny. [Music]: BGM remains constant. [SFX]: Distant bird chirping and the idle hum of a vehicle engine. (8) [Vocals]: Narrator's voice returns to clear quality, sounding nervous. [Music]: BGM transitions to a more tense rhythm. [SFX]: A digital notification 'blip' and UI click sound. (9) [Vocals]: Narrator pauses briefly to emphasize the date. [Music]: BGM tempo slows down significantly. [SFX]: A sharp 'tick' sound like a digital switch. (10) [Vocals]: Narrator speaks with a smug, deeper pitch. [Music]: BGM fades out into a low, quiet ambient bed. [SFX]: Brief silence. (11) [Vocals]: Narrator's voice stops entirely. [Music]: Complete silence. [SFX]: Faint sounds of fabric rustling as characters move in bed. (12) [Vocals]: A female voice speaks with a very flat, bored, and dismissive tone. [Music]: No music. [SFX]: Silence, emphasizing the anti-climax of the scene.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage -> Linear -> Reversal: Hook -> Narrative -> Anti-climax
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a dramatic, web-novel style 'rebirth' trope to build suspense and excitement, only to reveal it as a humorous anti-climax where the protagonist is simply watching a video in bed while being judged by his partner.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively parodies the 'Urban Rebirth' genre popular in web fiction.
